references.title: DWDS: können
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Etymologie: ahd. kunnan, a Germanic preterite-present verb, not built from another German word

notes.rationale: Der Fürst kann alles: können as a full verb, to be able to do (draw 84). DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word: the Root könn, as the infinitive shows it (the Root's other Surfaces, kann and konn, are its Lemma's), and the Ending en (ADR 0051).
